Local producer fixture: one note editor with a save button. Storage is required;
optional theme updates the entire surface, with a local fallback and teardown.
The no-domain run keeps an editable note and explains unavailable persistence.
There is no network, signer, relay, private key, or background service.

Only main.ts, styles.css and capabilities.json are submitted. The supervisor
owns bounded purpose metadata; the pinned CLI owns deployment configuration.
The build keeps the upstream package scripts, package-manager pin and frozen
lockfile. No generated configuration is evaluated by the coordinator.

This is a local/CI worker and metadata fixture, not a completed customer flow or
protected release suite. Real host storage interactions, lifecycle, four frame
sizes (200x160, 320x560, 900x600, 2400x1200), and both host themes remain required
before claiming the UI or publication path is accepted.
